faq.heading: Answers to Common Questions
faq.subtitle: Find clear answers about Ayurvedic treatments and appointments.
faq.q1: What is Panchakarma and who needs it?
faq.a1: Panchakarma is a 5-step Ayurvedic detoxification procedure that cleanses accumulated toxins from the body and restores Dosha balance.
faq.q2: Are Ayurvedic medicines safe to take with allopathy?
faq.a2: Yes, under proper medical guidance, Ayurvedic herbal formulations can be safely integrated into your health routine.
faq.q3: How long does a Panchakarma treatment session take?
faq.a3: Individual sessions usually take 45 to 75 minutes. A complete Panchakarma therapy package spans 7, 14, or 21 days based on diagnosis.
faq.q4: Do I need a prior appointment for consultation?
faq.a4: Yes, prior booking is recommended to ensure minimal waiting time and dedicated consultation time with the doctor.
faq.q5: What clinic hours are you open?
faq.a5: We are open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM. Sunday is closed.
